about: r86 v4.6 hunt: 80 new everyday first lines aimed at sentence structure (written for this pass, never tuned on before first contact): conditionals after a discourse marker ("So if…", "And when…", "And if…"), "because" clauses, relative clauses, lists, questions, a purpose "so I could", and run-ons (one over 280). On first contact v4.5 broke 6 of them (a stranded condition, a stranded "when", a stranded "as long as" in an alt, a purpose clause split off, a question split from its mark, a result move that ate a verb) and changed the meaning of 3 (a dropped "because", "really just want", "basically did"). v4.6: 0 broken, 0 meaning changes in every mode.
